name: Topre Corporation
summary: Topre Corporation engages in the press-related products and temperature-controlled logistics-related businesses in Japan, the United States, Mexico, China, Thailand, India, and internationally. The company offers press-related products; ultra-high-tensile steel plates and hot stamp pressed product; and constant temperature logistics products for light vehicles and heavy vehicles, as well as compact, 2t, 3t, and 4t trucks. It also provides air conditioning equipment, such as high performance fans and home ventilation system; and electronic products, such as keyboards, pin pads, touch monitor, touch panel, and embedded computer.
